summary: Suncrete, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Commitment Increase and Fifth Amendment to its existing credit agreement with Bank of America and other lenders. The amendment increases the revolving credit facility from $25M to $50M and adds a $175M delayed draw term loan facility maturing July 2029, available for refinancing prior acquisitions or funding permitted acquisitions. Proceeds are limited to acquisition-related uses, with customary commitment fees on undrawn amounts. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation transaction. No deal terms for a change-of-control, tender, or restructuring are present.
